Katalog / Arms and hands / PAROL6
N° 13 — Industrial robot armGPL-3.0
Kit for

PAROL6

Open-source design: Petar Crnjak (Source Robotics)

Six-axis desktop arm whose mechanics, control software and handling mimic industrial robots. Six NEMA 17 stepper motors with precision planetary gearboxes and belt drives, a controller board with an STM32F446 and TMC5160 drivers, 24 V power. 400 mm reach, up to 1 kg payload and 0.08 mm repeatability. Control it from the graphical PAROL6 Commander with a simulator, from Python, or via ROS 2 and MoveIt. Parts are printed in PETG.

05 — Project, licence, safetyLicence and safety+

This kit is based on the open project PAROL6, created by Petar Crnjak (Source Robotics). The design files are published under GPL-3.0, the software under GPL-3.0.

printedrobotics.cz prints the parts and assembles the kit from the bill of materials of PAROL6. The project’s authors are not affiliated with us and have not endorsed this product.

Safety notice

Not a toy. Contains small parts — choking hazard.

For ages 14 and up; younger children only under adult supervision. Moving parts can pinch fingers.
Strong motors: a moving arm can cause injury. Keep your hands out of reach during bring-up and keep the power switch within reach.
The pneumatic gripper runs on compressed air – use only an approved air supply and hoses.
Power the hardware in this kit only from the supply specified in the project instructions.

Kit manufacturer

printedrobotics.cz, Prague. Full manufacturer details and the declaration of conformity will be published before sales begin.
